title: Cap. IX Arg. 10 Sol cont.: God's intention through means is judged from the nature of the means, not from the evil event he foresaw and would not hinder — same of Gospel gifts to reprobates
pass_a_gloss: For (as we admonished before) the intention of God through means is always estimated from the nature of the means, and not from the evil event which God foresees will be, and wills not to hinder. In the same manner therefore is it to be thought of Evangelical preaching, and the other gifts of Divine grace which are granted unto the reprobate.
pass_b_english: For — as we warned before — God's intention through means is always judged from the nature of those means, not from the evil event he foresaw and would not hinder. Judge Gospel preaching and the other gifts of divine grace granted to the reprobate the same way.
source_text: Nam (quod antea monuimus) intentio Dei per media semper aestimatur ex mediorum natura, et non ex eventu malo, quem Deus praevidet fore, et non vult impedire. Eodem igitur modo de Evangelica praedicatione, aliisque gratiae Divinae muneribus, quae reprobatis conceduntur, sentiendum est.
